description: Set the resolutions one test case is generated and run at on a lane, e.g. ["R_0390x0844"] to verify it on a phone. Mints the test case's next test spec version: a resolution kept keeps its runSettings record and scripts, a new one gets a new record, and a dropped one's record is retired. The list replaces the whole selection, so read the current resolutions and featureFlags with muggle-remote-test-case-display-resolutions-get and pass back those to keep. Returns the same shape as muggle-remote-test-case-display-resolutions-get, read after the change.

displayResolutions.description: Resolutions the test case is verified at on this lane, one run each, e.g. ["R_0390x0844"]. Replaces the whole list; duplicates are dropped. The current primary stays primary while it is listed; otherwise the first listed becomes primary. Each must be enabled on the project lane (see enabledResolutions from muggle-remote-project-display-resolutions-get).

featureFlags.description: Feature-flag variants to keep, passed back verbatim from featureFlags of muggle-remote-test-case-display-resolutions-get. Omit to put the test case on the lane's default flags.

runEnvironmentType.description: Lane: 'remote' (cloud runs, the default) or 'local' (developer localhost).

runStrategy.description: Run strategy across the test case's resolutions: primaryOnly, primaryFirst or allAtOnce. null returns the test case to the project lane's strategy; omit to keep the current one.

name: muggle-remote-test-case-display-resolutions-update
